note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; only the soldier is described, the worker and the alate are not recorded; the original gives the third antennal segment in the OCR as “.22-32 mm.”, the head width as “1 . io-l. 17” and the left mandible length as “1. 77-1 .84”, treated here as 0.22–0.32 mm, 1.10–1.17 and 1.77–1.84 respectively; synonymy, figure numbers, localities and type-specimen data are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The anterior margin of the pronotum is deeply concave in M. bellicosi; M. gracilipes is larger and its head sides are less straight than in this species; in M. holmgreni the frontal projection is more raised and the head sides are also not straight.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, markedly narrowed anteriorly, the sides rather straight. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 very long (0.22–0.32 mm), segment 2 about as long as segment 4. Anterior margin of the labrum concave, ending in two points. Mandibles long and slender, black, suited to snapping. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly notched. Measurements (mm): head length including the mandibles 3.00–3.10, head width 1.10–1.17, antennal length 2.20, pronotal length 0.27, width 0.55, hind tibia length 1.27, left mandible length 1.77–1.84.
